module simple_pll (
    output reg [4:0] clk,
    input fbin,
    output fbout,
    input [1:0] inclk
);
    assign fbout = fbin;

    // Clock generation logic
    // For example purposes, we're simply passing through the inclk signals
    always @ (posedge inclk[0] or posedge inclk[1]) begin
        clk[0] <= inclk[0];
        clk[1] <= inclk[0];
        clk[2] <= inclk[0];
        clk[3] <= inclk[1];
        clk[4] <= inclk[1];
    end
endmodule
